service.en: Request for exemption from delay fees
service.ur: تاخیری فیس سے استثنا کی درخواست

about: Ask ICP to waive Emirates ID late fees in cases covered by approved exemption rules.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Must be filed together with an ID renewal or new issuance request
Covers cases such as an ID that expired after deportation or while the passport was held for a court case, with proof from the authority
Open to UAE citizens, residents and GCC citizens
documents: Supporting proof for the exemption reason
timing: ICP replies by accepting, rejecting or asking for changes
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
